name: States the game never plays for a player's bro
source: Decompiled Broforce game source: TestVanDammeAnim, BroBase, Map, ImprovedGestureSystem
note: The six gestures other than Flex have no input path in the game: the only caller passing one is ImprovedGestureSystem.DisplayGesture, which plays only a selection made while ImprovedGestureSystem.open is true (ImprovedGestureSystem.Update), and nothing writes open (ImprovedGestureSystem.open); RocketLib's optional gesture key bindings can trigger them. The dance plays only for units with playerNum < 0 (Map.MakeMooksDance, the one caller of Dance). The sweep can only force these by pinning fields, so base-states.json leaves them out; layer this list after it to sweep them. Unqualified member names in the entries are TestVanDammeAnim's; BroBase's are qualified.

states.name: gesture_salute
states.note: AnimateIdle's currentGesture != None arm -> AnimateGesture, overridden by BroBase.AnimateGesture which calls the base first. The cell is Mathf.Min(frame, span - 1) * 32 at (9 + gestureIndex) * 32 (AnimateGesture's last statement), giving row 9 for Salute. blockMovementForGesture true keeps Update's gesture clear from clearing the gesture whenever actionState is not Idle or fire or special is set, and AnimateGesture's own end-of-span clear from firing.

states.name: gesture_wave
states.note: AnimateIdle's currentGesture != None arm -> AnimateGesture, overridden by BroBase.AnimateGesture which calls the base first. The cell is Mathf.Min(frame, span - 1) * 32 at (9 + gestureIndex) * 32 (AnimateGesture's last statement), giving row 10 for Wave. blockMovementForGesture true keeps Update's gesture clear from clearing the gesture whenever actionState is not Idle or fire or special is set. This gesture loops by rewinding frame in AnimateGesture once frame exceeds its span; the stepped values stay inside the span so the rewind never fires.

states.name: dancing
states.note: AnimateIdle's dancing arm needs health > 0 && stunTime > 0 && dancingTime > 0 (and currentGesture None) -> AnimateDancingFrames: dancingFramesSheetPosition.x + frame % dancingFrames on row dancingFramesSheetPosition.y. The base defaults are (15, 14) and 12 frames (the dancingFrames and dancingFramesSheetPosition field initializers), so a bro that overrides them will address a different block than the expect below.
